text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on my way back from shopping,
in front of a tofu shop—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ugh, uwooh... Aaaahhhhhh~!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ugh... My "synapses" are... 
"Doppler"...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Che buooono!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, sorry for startling you. 
This soy milk was just so delicious,
you see.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The shopping district's soy milk is a "bonus
meal." 
Recommending it is unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's ottimo every single time!
Ever since the day we met,
we've been captivated by this soy milk!
choice_data_list: I had no idea the shopping distric...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
Even though this soy milk is so
delicious, 
hardly anyone knows about it...!
choice_data_list: I had no idea the shopping distric...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Please, I want you to drink this too. 
And play a melodia of joy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The soy milk you were handed looks perfectly
ordinary. 
First, you give it a sniff.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Listen, can't you hear it in the aroma? 
The voice of an artisan painstakingly
straining soybeans since early morning. 
Going, 'Hoo... whew, whew...!'—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yes, drink it right here!
Savor the subtle notes! 
The rich... heartfelt love of soy milk!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear it?
Blessed with all the love of the Earth and
the sun, 
it's an orchestra of soybeans and water!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The more you drink,
the more “luminescence.” 
Keep gulping it down...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A 'COMF' sound, huh. 
I'm sure the soy milk is happy to 'commune,'
too.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, indeed! The joy of soy milk... I 
can hear it, I can truly hear it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Now, 'tis time to raise a toast~♪ To our 
fateful meeting long dreamed of~♪"
choice_data_list: That song... is that the feelings ...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You two follow my lead! Play the 
heartfelt emotions of soy milk just as
you 
feel them!
choice_data_list: That song... is about how soy milk...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I merely wish to bring you pure
delight~♪ 
Wrapping you up in purest white~♪"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, 'tis time to make "contact"~♪ 
Orbiting 'round with curiosity~♪"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Filling every moment with pure
devotion~♪ 
Purest soul, for soy milk am I~♪"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
...What a strange song. Soy milk, huh... 
Haven't had any in a while.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, they sell soy milk here?! ...Looks 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Delicious, oh let me hear that word~♪ 
Love the soy milk, love the soy milk~♪"

text_block_list.name: Earth & Universe
text_block_list.text: "Love the soy milk~~~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Buonissimo... Thank you for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! One soy milk please... No, 
make it three!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp gulp gulp gulp*...! So good! What's 
with this ultra-smooth soy milk?! It 
soothes my soul~~~!!
choice_data_list: ...The love of soy milk is spreadi...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to think we could convey the love of 
soy milk to so many people... Thank you, 
it's all thanks to your wonderful chorus.
choice_data_list: ...The love for soy milk is spread...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Mm...
The soy milk's "contact" has not yet 
ceased.
choice_data_list: Thank you as well for the deliciou...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, let us love soy milk even more. 
And let us feel it with our tongues, our 
eyes, and our ears!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, raise your soy milk glasses in a 
toast. And with that――Salute!!
